text:
Inadmissible because specific acts cannot prove character. A defendant may offer character evidence of honesty only through reputation or opinion testimony (FRE 404(a)(2)(A), 405(a)), and a witness's account of the defendant repeatedly refusing black-marketeering offers is a specific instance offered to show he is honest. The background detail that he was an army supply sergeant does not cure this, since it offers no reputation or opinion about honesty.

CONFIDENCE: 80
